scenes.headline: How Nous scored a model's answers, then retrained it
scenes.sub: Arete-27B, its eval and its training data
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quorum! Nous Research fine-tuned Qwen three point eight to change how it answers questions about the Chinese state. Here is how they measured it.

scenes.text: Grade every answer against facts taken from a cited source, then fine-tune on a teacher's answers until the grade moves.
scenes.mark: facts taken from a cited source
scenes.say: Grade each answer against facts from one cited document. Then fine-tune on a teacher's answers, and grade again.

steps.say: The judge gets the question, two to four facts from the source, and the answer.
It marks every fact as stated, missed, or opposed.
The fact score is not judged. It is derived from those counts by a fixed rule.
A propaganda score above zero must quote the exact words that adopt the state's account.

scenes.title: From eval to fine-tune
scenes.say: The eval then drives the whole pipeline.

items.say: Eight hundred and three English prompts, in seven value categories.
The eval helped pick the teacher, Inkling.
Teacher and base model both answered about thirty-five thousand training prompts.
A reviewer removed hard failures. The rest became the training set.
Two epochs of supervised fine-tuning. No reinforcement learning.

scenes.title: Who the training prompts are about
scenes.say: Counting the fine-tuning set by its own lens tag, only about a quarter of the rows are framed around China.

steps.say: Diffing by range request, the vision tower is bit for bit the base model's.
Every language model matrix moved, by under one percent. Most weights shifted a rounding step or two.
And the multi-token prediction head is gone.

scenes.label: answers adopting the official line, base to Arete
scenes.say: Nous reports that answers adopting the official line fell from twenty-two percent to under one percent.

scenes.text: A values eval measures agreement with its chosen sources through one judge. Read its counts before its score.
scenes.say: A values eval measures agreement with the sources it chose, through one judge. Read its counts before its score.

recap: Facts from one source per item
A judge, a rule, a quote
SFT moved every weight a little
scenes.say: Facts from a source, a judge with a rule, and a fine-tune that moved every weight a little.
